QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Ex-chief Stan
QuestInfo.0: Supposedly, Empress Cygnus and the Knights became corrupted, and drove Henesys to ruin. Maybe there's been a misunderstanding. Listen to what the townspeople have to say. Particularly that one person, #bover by the gravestone#k...
QuestInfo.1: You encountered the ghost of Chief Stan. Despite being dead, he still cares for the town, and asked you to defeat around #r100 noisy #o8600000##k. Hunt them in #bHenesys Ruins Park#k or #bHenesys Ruins Market#k.
QuestInfo.2: The ghost of Chief Stan is certain that the Cygnus Knights brought the town's downfall. He asked you to protect what still remains of Henesys.

1.0: On the town's behalf, thank you. What the Cygnus Knights did to us, well, it's been hard to rebuild. I wanted to help, or at least supervise, but every time I've tried to talk to someone, they've just run away screaming.
1.1: Eh? Was it really the Cygnus Knights, you ask? YES. Yes, it was. I'm dead. What more proof do you need? Even now, I can't forget what I saw that day.

yes.0: You remind me of all those adventurers back in the old days, strong and helpful. If you have the heart for it, I'd love to see you to protect this town from the Cygnus Knights.

mob.0: Did you take care of those monsters yet? Those snails are causing a ruckus, you know.
